name: Stabbing Sentinel
source: Pathfinder #155: Lord of the Black Sands
description: A petrified creature momentarily animates to attack an adjacent creature.
disable: DC 40 Thievery check (master) to remove the animating magic without triggering the trap, or Dispel Magic (8th rank; counteract DC 38) to counteract the animating magic
reset: The magical energy that animates the statue builds up again over 24 hours and the trap resets.

offensiveAbilities.name: Animated Attack
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living or undead creature moves within 5 feet of the stabbing sentinel

Effect The stabbing sentinel animates, making one Strike against the triggering creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Petrification Overcharge
offensiveAbilities.description: On a critical hit, the target is Petrified for 1 round. Additionally, if another stabbing sentinel has already been triggered, that sentinel immediately resets. If no other stabbing sentinels have been triggered, then another random statue in the room becomes infused with animating magic and becomes another stabbing sentinel hazard (to a maximum of four at a time).
